checks.name: tests/test_tscheck_data_isolation.py (2 tests)
checks.evidence: pytest -> 2 passed. Owner A (Bastille) GET /shops/{Owner-B-shop-id}/orders -> 404; Owner A GET /admin/organizations/{Owner-B-org-id}/details -> 403. Super-admin's /admin/organizations/{org-B}/details documents/orders ids are fully disjoint from org A's; POST /admin/organizations/{org-B}/documents/{an org-A doc id}/link -> 404 (link is scoped by org_id, not just doc_id). Fixed a flaky first run: both tests originally called /auth/logout on the shared seeded Owner A/B accounts, which (per spec_deviations, logout revokes ALL sessions of that account) raced with other test files/xdist workers logged in as the same accounts and caused a transient 401; removed those unnecessary logout calls (the test's own httpx.Client is discarded at the end of the `with` block regardless) and reran clean twice.

notes: Fresh briefing (AI document generator in the customer portal, PRINTER-slot plan labels, persistent sessions/explicit logout, super-admin Agent profile, and strict per-org data isolation) distinct from iteration_6's marketing-homepage topic. 7 acceptance_matrix criteria, each requiring browser and/or backend artifacts per the API-backed-UI-criterion rule => 13 checks[] entries. Added 4 backend test files (test_tscheck_ai_docs_validation.py, test_tscheck_printer_plans.py, test_tscheck_persistent_login_logout.py, test_tscheck_data_isolation.py) and 4 new browser checks (customer-portal-ai-catalog, aidoc-generate-to-order-and-track, superadmin-agent-profile-tabs, persistent-login-session-and-logout) plus one public-preview-ingress pass (preview-printer-plan-and-ai-portal). Full backend suite: 88 tests, 87 passed, 1 failed (tests/test_stage1.py::test_superadmin_scope — the pre-existing, already-documented >1000-orgs issue called out in the briefing as unrelated). Used exactly 1 of the budgeted 2-3 real-LLM AI-doc generations (seed_facts: 15/IP/hour rate limit). No application bugs found. Fixture discipline: all AI-doc/order fixtures used tscheck-<prefix> customer/document names; the persistent-login-logout backend test registers its own fresh tscheck-<uuid> account rather than touching the shared seeded owner/super-admin credentials; the data-isolation and printer-plan backend tests read (never modify) the shared seeded Owner A/B/super-admin accounts and were adjusted to stop calling /auth/logout on them after diagnosing a genuine cross-test-file race (logout revokes all sessions of that account) — documented above as a flaky-then-fixed-at-the-test-level case, not an application bug.
